name: DeleteServiceNowIncident
label: Delete ServiceNow Incident
description: Deletes a ServiceNow incident by sys_id using a stored Credential ID / Token.

fields.name: CredentialId
fields.label: Credential ID / Token
fields.description: ServiceNow credential ID, Base64 token, or OAuth2 token

fields.name: IncidentId
fields.label: Incident sys_id
fields.description: sys_id of the incident to delete

fields.name: Response
fields.label: API Response
fields.description: Raw JSON response from ServiceNow API

fields.name: DeletedIncidentId
fields.label: Deleted Incident ID
fields.description: The sys_id of the deleted incident
